technique_name: Describe the most important features of a wine refrigerator.
description: A wine refrigerator is an essential appliance for any true wine lover. These refrigerators typically come with features such as temperature control, humidity control, UV-resistant glass door panels and vibration dampening. Temperature control allows you to store both red and white wines at optimal temperatures and conditions, while specific shelf arrangements provide the optimal light, ventilation and temperature to ensure that your collections will thrive.
